name: autopulse
description: autopulse is a lightweight service that updates media servers like Plex and Jellyfin based on notifications from media organizers like Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, and Readarr. Instead of triggering full library scans, autopulse sends targeted refresh requests for the specific items that changed.

paths.name: App data
paths.description: Holds config files, autopulse.db (SQLite), and the session key

paths.name: Media share
paths.description: Read-only mount of your media library. autopulse only reads file paths, so :ro is intentional. Mirror the paths your Sonarr/Radarr triggers will report.

ports.name: WebUI port
ports.description: HTTP port for the autopulse API and UI

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: Container user id. Unraid appdata is usually owned by nobody (99).

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: Container group id. Unraid appdata is usually owned by users (100).

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Connection string. For Postgres use postgres://user:pass@host/db

variables.name: Basic-auth username
variables.description: Basic-auth username. Change from the default before exposing.

variables.name: Basic-auth password
variables.description: Basic-auth password. Change from the default before exposing.
